title: Foundry Frontier Pack
description: Pack with industrial mods and new world generation
body:
This modpack combines elements of exploration, technology, and building to create a unique survival experience. With new power from TechReborn and Refined Storage modpack challenges player to forge their own path in an expansive world filled with new biomes and valuable resources to mine. Whether you're a seasoned adventurer or a curious beginner, this modpack offers something for everyone.

### Key Features:
- **Survival Meets Technology**: Build and manag machines with tech mods TechReborn and Refined Storage. Harness the power of automation to create complex factories and produce high-tech gadgets
- **Heaven (Aether)**: Venture beyond the clouds and into the mystical floating islands of the Aether dimension. A realm filled with magical creatures, rare resources, and challenging new bosses
- **See Beyond the Horizon**: Gives you the ultimate advantage in planning your next big adventure. Explore new areas with a fresh perspective as you marvel at distant mountain ranges, oceans, or mysterious forests in the far distance

### Important:
- For better overworld generation recommends to use [William Wythers' Overhauled Overworld](https://modrinth.com/datapack/william-wythers-overhauled-overworld-(datapack))
- Distant Horizons is disabled by default but if you have powerful PC you can enable it in settings
